svg.text: The same chart, one provider at a time
Every panel has the same axes as the chart above. The faint lines are the other providers' models.
Best-value effort: the last step costing at most 40% more per point

g.text: Relative cost per task (1 = a typical FrontierCode setting), log scale
Relative cost per task (1 = a typical FrontierCode setting), log scale

svg.text: One line per model, joining its efforts from lowest to highest. A dash pattern tells one provider's models apart. The marker's shape names the effort.
The number beside a name counts the suites that tested it at any effort, of 5. Data read 2026-11-24.
Suites: FrontierCode 2.0, VulcanBench v4, AA Intelligence Index v5.0.2, Vals Index 2.2, CursorBench 4.1.
